en.title: QED: electron–muon scattering at tree level
en.summary: One-photon exchange for e⁻μ⁻ → e⁻μ⁻: the amplitude, the propagator and the t-channel momentum transfer.

blocks.text: **Process** $e^-(k)\,\mu^-(p) \to e^-(k')\,\mu^-(p')$, one virtual photon exchanged between the two lines.

blocks.caption: Amplitude: two vertices and the photon propagator

blocks.latex: q = k - k' = p' - p,\qquad q^2 = (k-k')^2 = t
blocks.caption: Momentum transfer: a t-channel process

blocks.title: From the board
items: Each vertex gives −ieγ; the photon line gives −ig/q².
Integrating over x and y gives (2π)⁴δ⁴(q − p − p′): momentum is conserved.
For e⁺e⁻ annihilation the photon carries q² = (p + p′)² = s instead.
Masses: e⁻ ≈ 0.5 MeV, μ⁻ ≈ 106 MeV (the board's 130 is a slip).

blocks.question: Why is this called a t-channel diagram?
blocks.answer: The exchanged photon carries q² = (k − k′)² = t, the Mandelstam variable for momentum transfer.

zh.title: QED：电子–μ子散射（树图）
zh.summary: e⁻μ⁻ → e⁻μ⁻ 的单光子交换：振幅、传播子与 t 道动量转移。

blocks.text: **过程** $e^-(k)\,\mu^-(p) \to e^-(k')\,\mu^-(p')$，两条线之间交换一个虚光子。

blocks.caption: 振幅：两个顶点加光子传播子

blocks.latex: q = k - k' = p' - p,\qquad q^2 = (k-k')^2 = t
blocks.caption: 动量转移：t 道过程

blocks.title: 板书要点
items: 每个顶点给出 −ieγ，光子线给出 −ig/q²。
对 x、y 积分得到 (2π)⁴δ⁴(q − p − p′)：动量守恒。
e⁺e⁻ 湮灭时光子携带 q² = (p + p′)² = s。
质量：e⁻ ≈ 0.5 MeV，μ⁻ ≈ 106 MeV（板书上的 130 是笔误）。

blocks.question: 为什么叫 t 道图？
blocks.answer: 交换的光子携带 q² = (k − k′)² = t，即表示动量转移的 Mandelstam 变量。
